message.content: {"caption":"Utility curves across agent iterations, with annotated tool and agent changes at key improvements.","description":"A line chart plots Utility against Agent Iteration, from 0 to 15. The y-axis shows labeled ticks at 0.55, 0.60, 0.65, and 0.70; its plotted range extends below 0.55, so it does not start at zero. The blue line is Mean Utility, the red line is Best Utility So Far, and the pale-blue shaded band is the 95% Confidence Interval. The red best-so-far line never decreases: it rises from about 0.559 at iteration 0 to 0.585 at 1, about 0.599 at 5, about 0.603 at 7, about 0.647 at 9, and about 0.672 at 14, then stays level through 15. The blue mean line fluctuates around and often below the red line, reaching local highs near iterations 5, 7, 9, and 14, and dipping notably at 13 before rising sharply at 14. Labels with arrows point to changes: “Smart Edit” Tool points down to iteration 1; “Code Context Summarization” points up to iteration 5; “File Edit Verification” points down to iteration 7; “AST Symbol Locator” points down to iteration 9; and “Hybrid Symbol Locator” points diagonally down-right to iteration 14.
